title: Point One Deep Serve Setup (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance fusion 138bpm heavy bongo conga djembe slap bass spanish guitar pads synth lead trance buildup tribal claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro umpire voice]
Zero zero two we begin
Server in the right court ready
Receiver three feet behind
Paddle up split step waiting

[Verse 1 commentary]
Serve goes deep to the back third
Why because deep serve buys time
Receiver pushed back six feet behind
Giving server time to come in
Vamos vamos deep is gold
Uno dos tres position bold
Receiver returns deep down center
Classic safe smart enter

[Pre-Chorus]
Deep deep serve
Deep deep return
Deep deep serve
Watch and learn

[Chorus]
Point one deep serve setup point one deep serve setup
Deep is time deep is time
Point one deep serve setup point one deep serve setup
Vamos amigos play it prime

[Verse 2 coaching]
Server drives third shot drop low
Why because the drop arc slow
Time to walk to the kitchen line
Let them lift the ball just fine
Uno dos tres drop and walk
Mano blanda no shock
Four quick steps to the line
Ready stance and you are fine

[Bridge]
This point is about position
Not speed not pace not collision
Deep serve deep return drop and approach
Kitchen line is the coach

[Chorus]
Point one deep serve setup point one deep serve setup
Deep is time deep is time
Point one deep serve setup point one deep serve setup
Vamos amigos play it prime

[Outro]
Deep deep serve
Deep deep return
Drop and walk
Watch and learn
